goal: Port Martin package-zone rules (structure.rigidity + structure.uselessness) onto v3: REVIEW@WARNING verdicts at Package altitude. Zone membership via Structure.over(pkg).in_zone_of_pain()/in_zone_of_uselessness() + a D'>threshold (default 0.7) depth gate on martin_metrics().distance. Legacy rigidity.py/uselessness.py/architecture._run_zone_rule as oracle; two separate rules per int_c193d22c split decision.

summary.title: Port Martin package-zone rules (rigidity + uselessness)
summary.what: Added structure.rigidity (Zone of Pain) and structure.uselessness (Zone of Uselessness) as Package-altitude REVIEW verdicts. Zone membership comes from the metric layer (in_zone_of_pain / in_zone_of_uselessness); the rule adds the D'>threshold (0.7) depth gate, preserving the legacy `zone AND D'>0.7` predicate. Registered in RULE_REGISTRY (9->11). Shared 4-package fixture test.
summary.why: Recovers two of the legacy Martin 1994 architecture rules onto the v3 contract, consuming the already-built dependency-graph metric layer.

decisions.point: Verdict disposition for the Martin zones
decisions.chose: REVIEW action (caps at WARNING by ontology)
decisions.rationale: The anomaly is confident but the remedy is disjunctive and judgment-bound (introduce/attract abstractions vs reduce/delete); REVIEW caps at WARNING, which matches the legacy WARNING severity exactly.
rejected: A deterministic corrective action at ERROR (would over-prescribe a fix slop cannot adjudicate)

decisions.rationale: Matches the legacy split and the int_c193d22c decision; gives per-zone config granularity.
rejected: A single structure.packages rule emitting both zones
